room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (Gold low SI, Topaz, Ruby); actuals for Gold ₹2L+ & Platinum
room_rent.note: Gold plan SI ₹50k/₹1L/₹1.5L: 1% SI/day non-ICU, 2% SI/day ICU, capped at 35% SI/claim. Gold ₹2L+ and Platinum: actuals. Topaz and Ruby: 1% SI/day with co-payment if higher room chosen.

icu.display: 2% of SI/day (Gold low SI); actuals for Gold ₹2L+ & Platinum; 1% SI/day cap for Topaz/Ruby
icu.note: Gold SI ₹50k–₹1.5L: ICU up to 2% SI/day. Gold ₹2L+ and Platinum: actuals. Topaz/Ruby: no separate ICU cap stated beyond room rent; no co-payment for ICU admission.

copayment.display: None (base); zone co-pay 10–20% if treated in higher zone; room upgrade co-pay for Topaz/Ruby
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on Gold/Platinum for room rent. Topaz/Ruby: 0–25% co-pay on associated medical expenses if non-ICU room rent exceeds entitled limit. Zone 2 policyholders: 10% co-pay for Zone 1 treatment; Zone 3: 20% co-pay for Zone 1/2 treatment.

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits on Topaz/Ruby; cataract capped on Gold/Platinum; modern treatments 50% SI cap all plans
sub_limits.note: Gold/Platinum: cataract 10% SI per eye (min ₹15k, max ₹50k). Topaz/Ruby: extensive disease-wise sub-limits table (cataract, hysterectomy, CABG, knee replacement, dialysis, etc.). All plans: modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, etc.) capped at 50% SI per policy period.

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidental hospitalisation. Not applicable if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: Reduced to extent of prior continuous coverage via portability. No optional reduction add-on mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12 months: gastric/duodenal ulcers, urinary/biliary stones, ear/tonsil/adenoid surgery. 24 months: cataract, hernia, hydrocele, BPH, sinuses, DNS, fistula, haemorrhoids, hysterectomy, tumours/cysts, varicose veins, etc. 36 months: organ transplant, joint replacement (degenerative).

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl 18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. Miscarriage due to accident covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% increase per claim-free year on basic SI, max 50%. Reduced by 10% for each claim year. Base SI preserved.

restoration.note: Recharge benefit: 100% SI reinstated once per policy year after full exhaustion of SI + cumulative bonus. Available for SI ₹3L and above. Valid for all future claims (same or different ailment) in that policy year. Cumulative bonus not included in recharged amount.

pre_hosp.note: Gold and Platinum: actuals. Topaz and Ruby: up to 1% of SI.

post_hosp.note: Gold and Platinum: actuals. Topaz and Ruby: up to 1% of SI.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (400+ listed) plus any other agreed procedures

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation/treatment is explicitly excluded under specific exclusions (aa).

ayush.display: Covered (hospitalisation for illness/accident under AYUSH systems)
ayush.note: Preventive and rejuvenation treatments which are non-curative are not covered.

organ_donor.display: Covered (harvesting surgery only, under recipient's policy)
organ_donor.note: Donor screening, pre/post-hospitalisation for donor, and organ acquisition costs not covered.

ambulance.note: Gold and Platinum plans: ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. Topaz and Ruby plans: ₹750 per hospitalisation with overall limit of ₹1,500 per policy period.

modern_treatments.display: Sub-limited to 50% of SI per policy period (all plans)
modern_treatments.note: Covers robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy (monoclonal antibody injection), intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, stereotactic radiosurgery, balloon sinuplasty, HIFU, bronchial thermoplasty, vaporisation of prostate, IONM, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded in Annexure 2 (gloves, masks, syringes, etc.).

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment in India only. Treatment outside India is excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/quarterly/half-yearly premium. 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage not available during grace period (except where premium paid in instalments during policy period).

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Apply at least 45 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary treatment, OPD/outpatient treatment, maternity, infertility/IVF, treatment outside India, stem cell storage, durable medical equipment, dental (unless accidental), hormone replacement therapy

optional_riders.display: No optional riders/add-ons mentioned in the policy wording
